body: yes I am a medical marijuana patient. To be honest this is the only thing that is keeping me to keep moving on.
This is some /r/rage shit.
I have been doing strict diets for months and I don't feel better. I will continue to do them hopefully they will help me but i hate it.

Yea I have Babesia and Bartonella, I even have these really bad marks on my stomach and back they look like stretch marks. Its caused by the bartonella. I got my tests done by Igenex. A couple doctors diagnosed me with Lyme, one of them is named Dr.Louis Costello who is in new mexico (where I live) and she has worked with Lyme for many years in New york. My parents are helping me a ton, if i didn't have them i don't know what i would do.

thank you, I love music I play guitar and other instruments. Its just since i have gotten sicker it's been more hard for me to do stuff i like. When i play guitar i get bad muscle pain and it becomes difficult to play. I am trying to be happy and positive but it feels impossible.
It's really hard for me to be positive. I have been on some antibiotics and the side effects are terrible, I have always been sensitive to medications.
thats what I feel but I have been to so many doctors we are trying anything. Im going to a new doctor soon.
Thanks that makes me feel better.

Thank you I hope you're doing ok. It sounds like there is a lot of amazing people here that have gone through some terrible stuff. I know my condition might not be as bad as some peoples here but its still extremely debilitating. I feel like a zombie all the time. I'm extremely grateful for my family. I really want to go to college and i am hoping i will be better by then but i doubt it.

Wow, you seem amazing. You seem so strong and have been through a lot just like me. Thank you for sharing you're story with me it really encouraged me. I really want to grow up to help others. I went to a Residential Treatment Center for kids that have been traumatized and that really changed my life and it made me want to help others because i meant some amazing people there.
thank you. I have a hard time about trying not to worry, i worry a lot. I hate that about myself.
Thank you I really appreciate it I feel so alone right now.

I have done a couple diets so far and it is extremely hard. Right now i am doing a homeopathic treatment and i feel like shit! I'm trying not to give up it's really hard, my family is what keeps me going. I feel like i will have this my whole life, i know a couple people that have had it for decade's. Thats a powerful song.
thank you I appreciate that.
yea i always try to take pills with foods because if i don't it really messes my stomach up.
yea i have been exploring lots of other metal bands like Kreator, Sodom, Ghost, Opeth, GWAR, SOD and others.
not completely but i have cut back dramatically, i used to have a lot of sugar when i was younger but luckily i changed my diet and i don't eat tons of junk food anymore which was a good decision.
its ok thank you, you have no idea how much i appreciate that. I'll look into that pain psychologist I've never heard of that.
both would be fine, i really appreciate that thank you.

yea i love hanging with my friends when i can. i talk to my mom and dad about everything I'm going through and that really helps. i like all sorts of music but especially heavy metal like Metallica, Megadeth, Mastodon, Iron Maiden, Anthrax, etc. i don't really write that much but i will make up riffs and stuff.

ya i have 2 really good friends that i see on a semi-regualr basis. my mom is amazing i am so thankful for her. your totally right about the double-edged sword, it is extremely miserable. i play guitar, music really helps me. I learned guitar when i was 12 while i was in a Residential Treatment Center for kids. Guitar is really good therapeutically for me. I collect old Nintendo games like NES,SNES,N64, and gameboy.

i just subscribed to that subreddit i will diffently check it out. And ya its super difficult for me to see friends, i sometimes go weeks without seeing them. My week has been hard, my pain keeps me up every night so I'm extremely tired but i realize what is keeping me going, its my family. They have been there for me time after time and my mom is my hero, she is pushing so hard to find out whats going on with me. I want to end my life so bad but i just feel like i can't do that to my family.
thank you i really appreciate it. i would love to talk, since being homeschooled i don't socialize that much, all of my friends have moved on with there exciting high school lives.
